arguments.question: Across ANET, MU, META and NVDA, assess the latest filed operating trajectory, profitability/cash-flow and disclosed demand, concentration, supply-chain and regulatory risks relevant to 21/63 sessions; build clearly labeled bear/base/bull valuation sensitivities only where supported. For QQQ, do not model corporate earnings—identify look-through implications from dated sponsor holdings if material. Use SEC/company primary evidence and the seeded QQQ profile/holdings; stop once latest filings and dated holdings establish the key drivers and explicit gaps.
arguments.decision_impact: Could differentiate company-specific catalysts and risks from shared AI/capex exposure and determine whether valuation discussion is evidence-supported.
